note: Official names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is written in our own words for this entry and cites its sources. Hidden flags are as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them: 28 hidden (27 bronze, 1 gold).

trophies.guide: The Platinum arrives on its own once the other 54 trophies are done — there is no extra task behind it. The road there is the five story chapters, the side-character strands, and the long activity and collectible counts, roughly 200 hours in total. Work through the five roadmap stages in order and this one pops by itself at the end.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the story (Stage 1)
Clear the Strangers and side characters (Stage 2)
Finish activities, crime and collectibles (Stages 3-5)
Reach 100% Completion for A Long Road — the Platinum pops with it

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is usually the first trophy a player earns. Play through the opening: it teaches the basics and the trophy pops at the end. Nothing in it can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Start a new game and play Gone Fishing through to its end

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 1 ends. Play the chapter's missions in order and it comes on its own — but before the chapter closes, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude): it is the one interaction in the game that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission
Do the balcony meditation with Lucia before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude)

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 2 ends. A pure story trophy: finish the chapter's missions in order and no side content is needed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 3 ends. Like the other chapter trophies it comes from story progress alone — work through the missions in order.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play through Chapter 3 to its final mission

trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 4 ends. By now the big bank vaults have opened up (see Maximum Withdrawal), so it is a good moment to start the vault robberies alongside the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play through Chapter 4 to its final mission

trophies.guide: Pops for finishing the final story mission at the end of Chapter 5. The story has five chapters and runs about 60-80 hours; after the credits you keep playing in free roam, so nothing past this point is locked away.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play through Chapter 5 and finish the final mission

steps: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to its end

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it is awarded at the end of the mission itself.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play the mission Child's Play to its end

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends, as part of the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The mission trophy pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: The biggest single ask in the game: fill the 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion only after the story ends (progress made during the story already counts). The checklist is forgiving — it asks for roughly 60% of the game's true content, with most collectibles only partly required — but a few rows demand everything: all 39 Gang Operations, all 33 Underwater Discoveries, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 42 Drone Time Trials and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Work through the checklist row by row in free roam; the full numbers are in the 100% guides cited below.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion
Clear the robbery rows first: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 Vaults
Finish the all-or-nothing rows: 33 Underwater Discoveries, 42 Shooting Range golds, 42 Drone Time Trials, 15 Target Decks
Top up the partial rows: 100 Optional Tasks, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 stunts

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts come in four kinds — 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps, 397 in all — and the 100% checklist wants 300 of them, so keep going past 250. Under-the-bridge runs in a fast plane and stunt jumps in a fast car are the quickest bulk; Base Jumps need a parachute and a tall spot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Do stunt jumps in a fast car and under-the-bridge runs in a plane for bulk progress
Try Knife Flights between buildings and Base Jumps from tall spots for the other kinds
Keep going to 300 stunts — the 100% checklist wants them

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: catch a fish, hunt an animal, play golf, finish a Shooting Range course, play pool, score a basketball basket, play a video game, win a race and complete a stunt. A car race, a Race Challenge or a Top Fun Drone Race all count as the race, so the easiest path is a drone race you were going to run anyway.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Catch a fish and hunt an animal
Play golf, pool, a video game, and score a basketball basket
Finish a Shooting Range course, win a race, and complete a stunt

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The gold medals here are not especially hard, and they are also a full row of the 100% checklist, so this is required twice over. Work range by range; a challenge you gold once stays gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Visit each of the 12 Shooting Ranges
Gold every challenge at a range before moving to the next
Recheck Progress to confirm all 42 are gold

trophies.count: 14 Top Fun locations (42 Drone Time Trials)
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 Drone Time Trials in total — three per location — and the 100% checklist wants all 42 finished, so winning the race at each spot also banks the time-trial progress. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then push for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Visit all 14 Top Fun locations
Win the drone race at each location
Finish all 42 Drone Time Trials for the 100% checklist

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street races, Race Challenges and Top Fun Drone Races — and the 100% checklist raises the bar to 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20. Vary the vehicle and the event rather than repeating one race.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Win races across different types — street, Race Challenge and drone
Count only wins in races you have not won before
Keep going to 30 unique wins for the 100% checklist

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, and Cal's challenge is a head-to-head: out-fish Cal before time runs out. Bring your best rod and fish where the challenge puts you — the fight matters more than the spot.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Take up Cal's fishing challenge
Out-fish Cal before the challenge ends

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any one, at any arcade. The 100% checklist goes further and asks you to play all four video games, so try the other cabinets while you are there. Pick the game you find easiest and finish a full run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find an arcade and finish any one game
Play the other three video games too — the 100% checklist wants all four

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the Strangers & Freaks questlines: follow his missions as they appear on the map and the trophy pops at the last one. Like the other side-character finals, it is hidden on PlayStation until earned.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Follow Andy's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand also feeds the treasure-hunt collectibles — the 100% checklist wants 5 of his 7 treasure sets — so pick up his sets while you work through his missions.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Follow Kenton's missions as they appear
Collect his treasure sets along the way (5 of 7 for 100%)
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of the Strangers & Freaks questlines; follow his missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the last one.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Follow Billy's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. More than eight strands exist, so you can skip the ones you dislike — the trophy counts any eight you finish. The five named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each have their own final-mission trophy on top of this one.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Take stranger missions as their markers appear across Leonida
Finish any 8 full strands
The five named side characters count toward the eight

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of the Strangers & Freaks questlines; follow his missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the last one.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Follow Randy's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of the Strangers & Freaks questlines; follow his missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the last one.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Follow Tyrone's missions as they appear
Finish his final mission

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 in total, with 15 of them also on the 100% checklist. This is the one trophy that can be missed: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. Finish that balcony session before Chapter 1 ends — it is gone after that, and whether it is strictly required is still unconfirmed, so do it to be safe. The other 17 spots are found across the map in free roam — check Progress to see which you still need.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Meditation Spot Locations

steps: After Down to Earth, visit Jason's house in the morning and meditate with Lucia on the balcony — before Chapter 1 ends
Find the other 17 meditation spots across Leonida in free roam
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 as a backup

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand gives you Target Decks — 15 of them, all required for 100% — and this trophy is for taking down the one unique animal he asks for. Track it with the hunting tools the strand teaches you, and take the shot cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Take Bret's hunting missions
Track the unique animal he asks for and take it down
Finish all 15 Target Decks for the 100% checklist

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them, so three sets is just the start — keep collecting. Cards turn up across Leonida; work set by set rather than at random.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Collect cards across Leonida, working one set at a time
Complete any 3 full sets
Keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app scans things — vehicles, landmarks, sights — and the app unlocks automatically in Chapter 1. Scan everything unfamiliar as you play: vehicles, boats and aircraft count, and by the time the story is done you will be well on the way. The 100% checklist wants the same 100 scans.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Open the WAiNK app (automatic from Chapter 1)
Scan every unfamiliar vehicle, boat, aircraft and landmark you meet
Keep scanning until 100 locations are logged

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 Challenges in the game and the 100% checklist wants 70, so treat 50 as a milestone on the way to 70 — and skip the 10 hardest, since the checklist lets you. Pick the quick ones first (driving, combat and exploration challenges) and leave the grinds for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Work through the quick Challenges first — driving, combat, exploration
Reach 50 completed
Keep going to 70, skipping the 10 hardest, for the 100% checklist

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the two of you to four stars together — a robbery or a shooting spree will do it — then break line of sight and stay out of the search until the stars clear. Losing the cops with your partner beside you is the whole trick; do it somewhere with alleys and cover.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Build a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The three robberies must run together, and your wanted level must stay up the whole time — don't let it clear between shops. Plan a short route between three nearby shops, keep the getaway car close, and go in order.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Pick three nearby shops and plan the route between them
Rob them one after another with your partner, keeping your Wanted Level up the whole time

trophies.count: 100 vehicles discovered (200 of 277 base models for 100%)
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. 'Discover' means finding a vehicle you have not logged before — scan new ones with the WAiNK app as you meet them, and the count climbs on its own. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Scan every new vehicle you meet with the WAiNK app, including boats and aircraft
Reach 100 discovered
Keep going to 200 base-model vehicles for the 100% checklist

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode: trigger it in a fight with at least five enemies close together and drop five before it ends. A gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout gives you the crowd; a rifle helps.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies close together
Trigger Combat Focus and take down five before it ends

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off with it. Get to the runway as a plane is leaving, board it, and get airborne before security stops you. Expect a wanted level; a fast approach vehicle helps.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Go to VCIA as a passenger plane is departing
Board the plane and take off

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos are guarded military hardware, so expect a fight to take one — then put it to work. The trophy is about the tank, not the theft alone: drive it and use its cannon.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find a Rhino tank at a military site
Steal it, then use its cannon in combat

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no one spotting you. Plan the entry, move when the staff are not looking, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch the staff first
Rob it without triggering detection — if spotted, leave and retry

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. The eight large bank vaults open up during Chapter 4, through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — five vaults earn the trophy, all eight are needed for 100%. Plan each hit, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Reach Chapter 4 and the mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock the vaults
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time
Rob all 8 for the 100% checklist

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run the roads of Leonida — stop one, take what it carries and get away. Keep a fast car nearby and break line of sight quickly; the truck's guards and the police both respond fast.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Stop it, take what it carries, and escape

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner until no fog is left on the map. It pairs naturally with the other exploration counts — vehicles, animals, WAiNK scans and meditation spots — so explore with a purpose and the map fills itself in.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Drive, fly and sail into every corner of Leonida
Combine it with vehicle scans, animal studies and meditation spots as you go

trophies.count: 1 Illegal Operation per gang, 9 gangs (39 of 39 for 100%)
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one from each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in all: Kingfishers (3), Kolts & Associates (5), M7 (2), La Polilla Negra (2), Final Chapter (4), San4San (5), PTT Youngin$ (2), The Guardia Brothers (3) and Other Criminals (13). The map filter (Map, Robberies, Illegal Operations) shows them, and Progress, Gangs tracks how many of each gang you have hit. All 39 are needed for 100%, so this trophy is just the first one per gang — and be ready for a gang to send people after you when you rob them.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Illegal Gang Operations Locations

steps: Open the map filter: Map, Robberies, Illegal Operations
Rob at least one operation from each of the nine gangs
Clear all 39 for the 100% checklist

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach spot, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops from the moment itself. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by guide writers, so if it does not pop at once, try the obvious beachfront bar spots and give the scene a moment to register.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: Go to Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with a view
If it does not pop, try the other beachfront bar spots

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom window and out the other side — the trophy is for the exit, not the entry. The precise method is still unconfirmed in the published guides, so expect to try the showroom's big glass front at speed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: Take a car into a vehicle showroom
Smash your way out through the glass front

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley — and per KeenGamer, steal the three key valuables there and escape. The alley is also one of the Kolts' Illegal Operations (Kingpin Bowling), so the two goals overlap.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Illegal Gang Operations Locations

steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley (Kingpin Bowling)
Bowl there, and take the three key valuables and escape

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Per KeenGamer, this one is about the stats: maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Other lists treat it as a story trophy that lands while playing, so train Strength for both characters as you go and let it pop when it pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: Train the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia
Keep it maxed for both characters

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Per KeenGamer, this counts 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the choices and deeds the profile tracks across the game. Play naturally, make the choices the game offers, and the count reaches 500 well before the end; PSN tracks the running count.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Play the story and make the choices the game offers
Check the running count on PSN as it climbs toward 500

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No published guide has a confirmed method for this one yet — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed, and other lists treat it as a story trophy that lands while playing the campaign. Don't hunt for it: play the story and it should come to you; if it hasn't by the credits, check the newest guide updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

If it has not popped by the credits, check the newest guide updates

Like Bad Luck, I Guess, this one has no confirmed method in the published guides — it appears to be tied to a strange story moment, and other lists treat it as a story trophy. Play through the campaign and watch for the odd event; the guide writers are still confirming the trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

If it has not popped by the credits, check the newest guide updates

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Per KeenGamer and GamesFuze, the trophy is for knocking targets down with a melee drive-by — attacking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The precise method is still being confirmed, so try it against a group of pedestrians from a slow-moving car and repeat until it registers.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Take a melee weapon into a moving vehicle
Drive slowly past a group and strike from the vehicle

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; your contacts wash them into clean cash, and the total is cumulative across the whole game. The same $250,000 is a row of the 100% checklist, so launder everything you earn rather than sitting on it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is washed

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts and the total is cumulative — weapons, clothes, food, car mods, whatever you buy. It climbs on its own across a normal playthrough; if you are close at the end, a round of big-ticket shopping finishes it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Buy weapons, clothes, food and car mods as you play
Top up with big-ticket shopping if you are close at the end

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight of them. Garages are bought as properties across Leonida; each one is a place to store vehicles as well as a trophy step. Buy them as you can afford them — the money from robberies and fencing covers them comfortably by the endgame.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Buy garage properties across Leonida as you can afford them
Own all eight

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you find; register ten different ones and the trophy pops. It pairs with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good — register the interesting ones as you scan them.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register 10 different vehicles you find
